Opening your dashboard…

EGX Daily

Add it to your Home Screen first, so it opens like an app.

  1. Tap the Share button (the square with an arrow). On newer iOS it can be under the ⋯ button.
  2. Scroll down, tap Add to Home Screen, then Add.
  3. Open EGX Daily from your Home Screen and enter your code there.

Enter your code to open your dashboard.

The code is checked on this device and never sent anywhere. Your numbers are kept encrypted on the web.
